about_the_game:
[About this game]

Meta Lines 2 is a minimalist puzzle game where your only goal is to connect all the points with lines and proceed to the next level.

[Gameplay]

As in the previous game:

  • 1.Click on checkpoint and drag the line to a common point to create a short line.

  • 2.You need to gradually connect the lines between two identical checkpoints.

  • 3.All points must be connected by lines, and you cannot leave any point unconnected.

  • 4.The lines you draw cannot cross each other.

Once all your lines satisfy these conditions, you win the level and proceed to the next one.

[Game Features]

  • 1.Carefully designed puzzles, each level is hand-drawn.

  • 2.As the levels increase, so does the difficulty.

  • 3.A minimalist interface that provides you with the most comfortable visual experience.

  • 4.Several color themes to choose and swap, preventing aesthetic fatigue.

  • 5.You can use either white or black as the primary color.

  • 6.Several quiet, relaxing, and soothing ambient music tracks to relieve mental fatigue.

  • 7.Steam Cloud saves, so if your game data is accidentally wiped or you switch computers, you can always download your progress via Steam Cloud.

  • 8.Supports multiple languages such as English, Russian, Chinese, French, etc. (Due to font compatibility issues, this will be gradually updated, please be patient while playing).

Thank you for your feedback and support for Meta Lines 2. If you encounter any issues in the game, see any misleading content on the store page, wish to provide feedback, or just want to say hello, feel free to reach out through the Steam game forums or email. I will try to take time out of my schedule to chat with you, but if I don’t respond to your message right away, I apologize as it may have slipped through or I’ve been too busy, I will try my best to avoid that.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. I sincerely hope you enjoy my game.     Y.J. --- Matrix Science

This page was translated with ChatGPT. If there are any misleading content, errors, or cultural sensitivities, please contact me through Steam Community or email.

short_description: When you feel bored, tired and dazzled by the cool game pictures, it's better to play a relaxed, intellectual and simple leisure game Meta Lines 2, which is suitable for playing while waiting in line for another game. Wish you have a good time !
